title: 第12章 家族群曝光了
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
周二。

    9:25分。

    竞价阶段出现-2%的跌幅。

    -2个点开盘，导致昨天进场的瞬间吓了一个哆嗦。

    不仅如此，接下来的时间，都在水面下横盘。

    不涨上去，也不大跌下去。

    就是用钝刀子在割肉。

    李西海看了预知详情知道。

    这是昨天进场的资金在吃带血的筹码。

    他们怎么可能好心的带散户一起吃肉？

    昨天是接力要筹码，稳定情绪。

    现在是把昨天进场的一些不坚定的人给洗出来。

    事实也是如此，昨天很多进场的，都坚持不住，纷纷交出筹码离场。

    整个上午，都处于阴跌的状态。

    这样的走势，很是打击看好的投资者。

    不过，也有坚定，继续看好的。

    迎来的却是不少离场散户的调侃。

    下午开盘。

    连续一个小时都没有大动静。

    直到14：28分，在大A有着神奇时间之名的时间点。

    突然大资金扫货，一路向上攀升。

    不管什么压力位，不管有多少挂单。

    统统吃掉。

    一支穿云箭，千军万马来相见。

    一根笔直的天线，直冲顶部。

    拉出一个超级大阳线出来。

    一分钟不到的时间。

    久岸医疗。

    成功封板涨停！

    “卧槽，天线！”

    “这尼玛，太残暴，太牛笔了。”

    “还好老子没走，坚定持有。”

    “主力是真特么狗啊，就要吃我的筹码呗？”

    “我刚出，你就拉涨停，是人啊你。”

    “草拟大坝，我挂了三个点，特么的来不及撤就被扫了。”

    一个涨停，笔挺的天线，超级大阳柱顶破苍穹。

    瞬间就让充满悲观情绪的久岸医疗论坛，满血复活。

    清一色的都是叫嚣呐喊的。

    “跑路的，现在出来继续叫唤？”

    “哈哈，就你们这些意志不坚定的，活该吃不上肉。”
content_en:
Tuesday.

    9:25 minutes.

    There was a -2% drop during the bidding stage.

    -The market opened at 2 points, which caused me to tremble when I entered the market yesterday.

    Not only that, the rest of the time was spent sideways under the water.

    It doesn’t go up, nor does it fall down.

    Just cutting the flesh with a dull knife.

    Li Xihai knew the details after reading the prediction.

    This is the money that entered the market yesterday eating bloody chips.

    How could they kindly bring retail investors to eat meat together?

    Yesterday was a relay to get chips and stabilize the mood.

    Now is the time to wash out some of the unsteady people who entered the market yesterday.

    This is also true. Many people who entered the market yesterday could not hold on and handed over their chips and left.

    The entire morning was in a state of decline.

    Such a trend is a huge blow to optimistic investors.

    However, there are also those who are firm and continue to be optimistic.

    What ushered in was ridicule from many retail investors who left the market.

    Opening in the afternoon.

    There was no big movement for an hour.

    Until 14:28, a time point in Big A that is known as the magical time.

    Suddenly big funds started buying goods, and prices climbed all the way up.

    No matter what the pressure level is, no matter how many pending orders there are.

    Eat them all.

    An arrow pierces the clouds, and thousands of troops come to meet you.

    A straight antenna, straight to the top.

    Pull out a super big positive line.

    Less than a minute.

    Jiu'an Medical.

    Successfully sealed the daily limit!

    "Damn it, antenna!"

    "This is so cruel, so awesome."

    "Fortunately, I didn't leave. I will hold on firmly."

    "The main force is such a bitch. Are you going to take my chips?"

    "You raised the limit as soon as I came out. You are a human being."

    "Drafting the dam, I attached three points, but I was swept away before I had time to withdraw."

    A daily limit, a straight antenna, and a super big sun pillar breaking through the sky.

    In an instant, the Jiu'an Medical Forum, which was full of pessimism, came back to life with full health.

    All of them were shouting and shouting.

    "Running away, come out now and continue shouting?"

    "Haha, you guys who are weak-minded deserve not to be able to eat meat."
title_en: Chapter 12 The family group is exposed
